title: One transformer layer: Q/K/V projections, attention, and the residual lane
why: It shows the layer's dataflow and the one thing a box sequence hides: the residual stream bypasses every sublayer and is added back, so information from earlier layers survives.
bypass: residual lane: x is added back, never replaced
note: Every token runs this lane. Attention mixes positions; the feed-forward layer transforms each one alone.
